about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm a frontend developer based in Pavia, Italy. I started out building interfaces on legacy stacks for banks and insurance companies, and for the past few years I've been maintaining and developing DeAgostini Publishing's public-facing websites, gradually weaving AI-assisted development tools into my workflow. I like code that ages well: readable today, easy to update three years from now.

continuous updates of the project's libraries and frameworks.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
privacy.intro: This page describes how the personal data of visitors to this site — a personal portfolio — is processed.

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is Andrea Dondoni, reachable at andreadondoni.privacy@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: The site collects browsing data in aggregate, anonymous form through Google Analytics 4 (pages visited, visit duration, device type, traffic source). This data is collected only after the user's consent. The CV download is a static file and involves no additional data collection.

sections.heading: Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: The data is used solely for statistical purposes, to understand in aggregate form how the site is used. The legal basis for processing is the user's consent (Article 6(1)(a) of EU Regulation 2016/679).

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: Google Analytics 4 is loaded through Google Tag Manager only after consent and may set measurement cookies. No analytics cookie is set before consent. Your consent choice is stored using the browser's localStorage, a technical technology needed to remember the preference and not subject to consent.

sections.heading: Third parties and data transfer
sections.body: Statistical data is processed by Google (Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager). Google may transfer data to the United States; such transfer is governed by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, under which Google LLC is certified.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Google Analytics data is retained according to the platform's retention settings. Your consent preference remains stored in your browser until you change it or clear the site's data.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability under Articles 15-22 of the GDPR by writing to andreadondoni.privacy@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (garanteprivacy.it).

sections.heading: Withdrawing consent
sections.body: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time through the "Manage cookies" link in the site footer. Withdrawal takes effect for subsequent visits.
